description: This file contains unit tests for the DateTimeUtil class, verifying its ability to parse various date/time string formats and handle boundary conditions and errors.

classes.name: DateTimeUtilTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that validates the behavior of DateTimeUtil's date/time parsing methods and exception handling.

methods.name: dateTimeUtilShouldNotCrashDuringInitialization
methods.description: Setup method to ensure DateTimeUtil's static parts do not crash during class initialization.

methods.name: assert19700123T012345_1337
methods.description: Helper method to assert the correctness of OffsetDateTime objects corresponding to a specific date and offset.

methods.name: parseExpandedFormat
methods.description: Tests parsing dateTime strings in expanded ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

methods.name: parseBasicFormat
methods.description: Tests parsing dateTime strings in basic ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

methods.name: parseShortExpandedFormat
methods.description: Tests parsing short expanded dateTime string with positive offset.

methods.name: parseShortBasicFormat
methods.description: Tests parsing short basic dateTime string with positive offset.

methods.name: parseZuluTime
methods.description: Tests parsing dateTime string with 'Z' (UTC timezone).

methods.name: monthTooBig
methods.description: Ensures DateTimeException is thrown when month exceeds valid range.

methods.name: dayTooBig
methods.description: Ensures DateTimeException is thrown when day exceeds valid range.

methods.name: hourTooBig
methods.description: Ensures DateTimeException is thrown when hour exceeds valid range.

methods.name: minuteTooBig
methods.description: Ensures DateTimeException is thrown when minute exceeds valid range.

methods.name: leapSecondsNotSupported
methods.description: Ensures DateTimeException is thrown for leap second timestamp.

methods.name: secondTooBig
methods.description: Ensures DateTimeException is thrown when seconds exceed valid range.

methods.name: offsetHourTooBig
methods.description: Checks for exception when offset hour is beyond valid range.

methods.name: offsetMinuteTooBig
methods.description: Checks for exception when offset minute is beyond valid range.

methods.name: offsetSecondsNotSupported
methods.description: Checks for exception when offset seconds are included, which are unsupported.

methods.name: offsetMillisecondsNotSupported
methods.description: Checks for exception when offset milliseconds are included, which are unsupported.

methods.name: notZuluTime
methods.description: Checks for exception when date/time string is improperly formatted, not ending with 'Z' or proper timezone.
